ETC.Atmosphere.Darkness1: One flame remains. The Last Stand begins while the darkness waits, vast, still, and merciless.
ETC.Atmosphere.Darkness2: Only two flames still resist. Darkness turns absolute, heavy and silent, ready to swallow everything.
ETC.Atmosphere.Darkness3: Almost nothing remains to hold back the dark. Shadows press close, thick and impossible to ignore.
ETC.Atmosphere.Darkness4: Darkness takes all the space. Every light strains beneath its weight, and each breath feels threatening.
ETC.Atmosphere.Darkness5: Half the flames are gone. Darkness no longer surrounds the group; now it seems to watch them.
ETC.Atmosphere.Darkness6: Light grows scarce. Shadows devour every outline, leaving a dull, almost tangible dread.
ETC.Atmosphere.Darkness7: Darkness spreads further. Each flame seems frailer, as though the dark were learning to smother them.
ETC.Atmosphere.Darkness8: The light retreats. Shadows thicken and close in; their silence seems to await the slightest weakness.
ETC.Atmosphere.Darkness9: A flame goes out. Darkness grows, still contained, yet close enough to weigh upon every breath.
ETC.Atmosphere.Departure1:
You reach the end of your path.

Your light drifts away, leaving the others strength to carry on.
ETC.Atmosphere.Departure10:
You reach the final line of your story.

The curtain falls quietly, and a soft, steadfast light remains.
ETC.Atmosphere.Departure2:
You leave the circle of flames.

Your passage remains, a quiet mark the darkness cannot erase.
ETC.Atmosphere.Departure3:
Your journey ends here.

Your story closes quietly, but your traces will follow the others.
ETC.Atmosphere.Departure4:
You yield your place to silence.

What you carried lingers in the air, ready to guide those who remain.
ETC.Atmosphere.Departure5:
Your road bends elsewhere.

You fade from the tale, but the echo of your choices stays with the group.
ETC.Atmosphere.Departure6:
You cross a threshold the others cannot follow.

Your light withdraws, though your memory still walks beside them.
ETC.Atmosphere.Departure7:
Your chapter ends.

The page turns gently, while what you planted lives on in the story.
ETC.Atmosphere.Departure8:
You leave the circle for an unseen horizon.

A glow remains behind you, beyond the darkness’s reach.
ETC.Atmosphere.Departure9:
Your path parts from the others.

Your presence fades, but some trace of you remains with those who go on.
